name: sceneone-site
description: Scene One — serverless dependencies only (the frontend stays buildless). Node is pinned to 22.x deliberately: @sparticuz/chromium v131 fails to extract its bundled libs on Node 24 (libnss3.so never lands in /tmp), which kills the PDF function. Do not bump to 24 without upgrading that package and re-testing /api/report-pdf on a deployment.
